newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - March 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New airport planned for Dubai near Jebel Ali Free Zone by the year 2012.
- Kuwaiti sheikh killed in Abu Dhabi powerboat race.
- UAE nationals to get priority for bank jobs.
- U.S. investment body, the Overseas Private Investment Corp, signs guarantee pact with the $45 million Inter-Arab Investment Fund.
- The UAE Chapter of International Advertising Association to draft voluntary code of ethics.
- Ajman witnesses construction boom. UK building materials firms keen to take slice of the action.
